get.description:
/v4/data/prediction/events

100 credits per API call

List prediction-market events across supported platforms. An event is a top-level grouping of one or more markets that share a common question or outcome set (e.g. "2028 US Presidential Election"). Each event row includes a roll-up of nested market counts, total volume, and total liquidity, with an opt-in to embed the full list of nested markets via includeMarkets=true.

Supported platforms (filter via platform or omit for a cross-platform feed):

  • Polymarket — polymarket
  • Kalshi — kalshi

Filtering, sorting and pagination

  • The status, category, tag and search filters are only honoured by Polymarket. To use any of them you must also pin platform=polymarket — calling them without that pin returns 400 so the response is honest about what was filtered.
  • sort accepts volume_desc, liquidity_desc, endingSoon, newest. When omitted on a cross-platform feed, results are interleaved so neither platform dominates the first page.
  • Pagination is cursor-based. The first call returns a pagination.cursor; pass that value verbatim as ?cursor=… on the next call. Cursors are opaque, fingerprint-bound to the filter set, and expire when filters change — never construct or modify them by hand. The cursor field is omitted from pagination on the last page.

Other notes

  • volumeUnit is usd on Polymarket events (dollar-denominated volume) and contracts on Kalshi events (number of contracts traded, not USD).
  • totalLiquidity is null on Kalshi — quoted liquidity is not exposed at the event level on Kalshi; compute from per-market orderbook depth if you need it.
  • status in the response is the verbatim upstream status string (richer than the status filter enum) — values can include paused, archived, settled, etc.
  • markets is populated only when includeMarkets=true is passed; otherwise it is null. When populated, every nested market is returned (no internal cap).

parameters.description: Filter to a single platform. Omit for a cross-platform feed.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description:
Filter by lifecycle status. Polymarket-only — must be combined with
`platform=polymarket`.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description:
Filter by event category. Polymarket-only — must be combined with
`platform=polymarket`. Free-form string, max 64 characters.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description:
Filter by event tag slug. Polymarket-only — must be combined with
`platform=polymarket`. Free-form string, max 64 characters.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description:
Free-text search across event titles. Polymarket-only — must be combined with
`platform=polymarket`. Max 256 characters.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description:
Sort order. When omitted on a cross-platform feed, results are interleaved
to balance the two platforms; otherwise sorted within the merged set.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description:
Opaque cursor returned by the previous response's `pagination.cursor`.
Omit on the first call. Fingerprint-bound to the filter set — changing
filters invalidates the cursor.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20 when omitted.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
When `true`, each event includes its full nested `markets[]` array. Defaults
to `false` to keep list payloads light — opt in when you need per-event
market depth.
parameters.name: includeMarkets

PredictionMarketStatusFilter.description:
Coarse lifecycle filter used by the `?status=` query parameter. The response field
`status` carries a richer, platform-native string (e.g. `paused`, `archived`,
`settled`); this enum is used only for filtering.

PredictionMarketSort.description:
Sort order for event and market listings. When omitted on a cross-platform feed,
results are interleaved between platforms instead.

PredictionVolumeUnit.description:
Unit for `volume` and `totalVolume` fields. `usd` on Polymarket (dollar-denominated
notional); `contracts` on Kalshi (contract count — not USD).

PredictionCursor.description:
Opaque base64-encoded pagination token. Returned in `pagination.cursor` on
responses that have more pages. Pass back verbatim as `?cursor=…` to fetch the
next page. Cursors are fingerprint-bound to the filter set — modifying any
filter between calls invalidates the cursor and returns `400`. The field is
omitted from `pagination` on the last page.

PredictionMarketSource.description: Upstream platform attribution for a market or event row.

platformId.description:
Platform-native identifier. Polymarket condition id (0x + 64 hex) or numeric
event id; Kalshi market or event ticker.

url.description: Canonical public URL on the source platform.

PredictionMarketOutcome.description: One outcome of a market (e.g. YES / NO for a binary market).

tokenId.description:
Polymarket CTF token id for this outcome (numeric string). `null` on Kalshi —
Kalshi outcomes are not tokenised.

PredictionMarketResolution.description:
Resolution payload populated only after a market has settled. `null` on every
active or paused market.

outcome.description: Winning outcome name (matches one of the market's `outcomes[].name`).

resolvedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market was resolved at.

txHash.description:
On-chain resolution transaction hash when available. `null` on Kalshi (the
resolution is recorded off-chain on Kalshi's side).

source.description:
Resolution source attribution (e.g. `uma`, `kalshi`). `null` when the upstream
does not expose it.

PredictionEventMarket.description:
Market row as nested inside an event. Same shape as the top-level
`PredictionMarket` minus the `chain` block (which is only surfaced on the
dedicated markets endpoints).

id.description: Platform-native market identifier (Polymarket condition id or Kalshi market ticker).

eventId.description:
Parent event id. Polymarket numeric event id, or Kalshi event ticker.
`null` when the upstream does not group this market under an event.

question.example: Will Elon Musk land humans on Mars by 2030?

description.example: Resolves YES if SpaceX confirms a successful crewed Mars landing by 2030-12-31.

tags.description: Free-form tag slugs. May be empty on Kalshi.

imageUrl.description: Image / icon URL for the market, when available.

status.description:
Verbatim upstream status string. Richer than the `?status=` filter enum —
values can include `paused`, `archived`, `settled`, `determined`, etc.

openTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market opened for trading.

closeTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market closes / closed for trading.

settleTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market is expected to settle.

liquidity.description:
Quoted-resting-orders depth. `null` on Kalshi — the upstream markets feed
does not populate this; aggregate orderbook depth client-side if you need it.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market was created upstream.

PredictionEvent.description:
Top-level event row — a grouping of one or more markets sharing a question or
outcome set. Aggregate fields (`marketCount`, `totalVolume`, `totalLiquidity`)
are server-computed roll-ups over the event's markets.

id.description: Platform-native event identifier (Polymarket numeric id or Kalshi event ticker).

title.example: Will Elon Musk land humans on Mars by 2030?

description.example: Outcome resolves on confirmation of a successful crewed Mars landing.

tags.description: Free-form tag slugs. May be empty on Kalshi.

imageUrl.description: Image / icon URL for the event, when available.

status.description: Verbatim upstream status string. Richer than the `?status=` filter enum.

marketCount.description: Number of markets attached to this event.

totalVolume.description: Sum of nested-market volume, in `volumeUnit` units.

totalLiquidity.description:
Sum of nested-market quoted liquidity. `null` on Kalshi events because the
underlying market liquidity is not exposed there.

markets.description:
The event's markets. **Never null.**
- When the request passes `includeMarkets=true`, each entry is a full market object.
- Otherwise (default, `includeMarkets=false`), each entry is a **market ID string**.
  The id is exactly what the get-market-by-id endpoint accepts — copy an id and call
  `GET /v4/data/prediction/markets/{id}` to fetch that market's full details.

PredictionCursorPagination.description:
Cursor-based pagination wrapper. The `cursor` field is omitted on the last
page; `pageSize` reflects the page size of the call that produced this response.

pageSize.description: Page size of the page that produced this response.
